changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS expenses ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, amount TEXT NOT NULL, currency TEXT NOT NULL, merchant TEXT NOT NULL, date TEXT NOT NULL, category TEXT, user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, receipt_photo_id TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, deleted_at TEXT );

changeSet.author: expense-report

not.sqlCheck: SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pragma_table_info('expenses') WHERE name = 'deleted_at') THEN '1' ELSE '0' END

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE expenses ADD COLUMN deleted_at TEXT

changeSet.author: expense-report

not.sqlCheck: SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pragma_table_info('expenses') WHERE name = 'user_key') THEN '1' ELSE '0' END

changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE expenses_new (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, amount TEXT NOT NULL, currency TEXT NOT NULL, merchant TEXT NOT NULL, date TEXT NOT NULL, category TEXT, user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, receipt_photo_id TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, deleted_at TEXT, user_key TEXT);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uk ON expenses_new (user_id, user_key);

INSERT INTO expenses_new (id, amount, currency, merchant, date, category, user_id, receipt_photo_id, created_at, deleted_at) SELECT id, amount, currency, merchant, date, category, user_id, receipt_photo_id, created_at, deleted_at FROM expenses;
ALTER TABLE expenses_new RENAME TO expenses;

changeSet.author: expense-report
changeSet.sql: UPDATE expenses SET user_key = ( SELECT substr(ranked.date, 1, 4) || substr(ranked.date, 6, 2) || substr(ranked.date, 9, 2) || '-' || ranked.n FROM ( SELECT id, date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id, date ORDER BY id) AS n FROM expenses WHERE user_key IS NULL ) AS ranked WHERE ranked.id = expenses.id ) WHERE user_key IS NULL;
